stem: Canyons and mesas are two landforms found in the western part of the United States. Which statement best describes how canyons and mesas are similar?

options.label: A
options.text: Both were formed by slow-moving glaciers.

options.label: B
options.text: Both were formed by erosion by wind and water.

options.label: C
options.text: Both were part of a mountain that was weathered by ice.

options.label: D
options.text: Both were part of a desert that was reshaped by a flood.
